Punjab BJP Appoints New District Presidents

The Punjab unit of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has appointed six new district presidents. This organizational move is aimed at strengthening the party's presence and structure within the state. The appointments are part of an ongoing effort to bolster the party's organizational capabilities across various districts.
